facts.title: Spicy Quick Pickled Radishes
ingredients: ¾ cup white wine vinegar or apple cider vinegar
1 teaspoon red pepper flakes (this yields very spicy pickles, so use ½ teaspoon for medium spicy pickles or none at all)
Optional add-ins: garlic cloves, black peppercorns, fennel seeds, coriander seeds
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
